system_name: OsintNeoAi & TaxFunded Autonomous Task Management Engine
description: Unified task queue that captures all AI suggestions, splits them into AI Autonomous Execution Tasks or Outreach/Human Action Tasks, and feeds them into FOIA/Complaint/Whistleblower or Suggestive Work pipelines.

CONTACT_SITE_ADMIN.description: This covers anything to contact us about. It is the ONLY task type the dev/admin team answers to.

SUGGESTIVE_WORK.description: Autonomous AI work. The AI handles this off-hours or after the user finishes their current focus.

FAILED_COMPLETELY.description: Tasks that hit a total dead end. Placed on this list and INSTANTLY sent to the dev team via telemetry. No reply required by admins, just for failure tracking.
